_about: Fixed wording. A proposal can show or hide a line where its section allows, but cannot reword it; an admin unlock is logged (Phase 2). Sources are recorded per line. {name} and {phoneDisplay} are filled from lib/brand.js (the keys must exist there; the build fails if one does not). Lines marked adapted change one word from the source (document -> proposal, website -> proposal) and are listed in docs/open-items.md for TEXC to approve.

preliminaryStatus.text: This proposal is not a final blast design or authority to undertake blasting. Final work areas, methodology and controls remain subject to further exposure, assessment and applicable approvals.

noBlastingUntil.text: No blasting activity will proceed until the relevant work area has been assessed, required controls have been confirmed, and applicable approvals and authorisations are in place.

progressive.text: The work is expected to be undertaken progressively rather than as a single unrestricted blast. Each section will be treated as its own controlled work area and reassessed before progression.

paramsLine.text: Parameters are preliminary and indicative only. This proposal is not a final blast design or authority to undertake blasting.
paramsLine.source: Brief section 5, row 09, built on the Chalmers Lane status wording

sitePlanLabel.text: APPROVED PROJECT MAP — DO NOT REDRAW OR INFER BOUNDARIES

envLimitsNote.text: Limits as set by the site approval / regulator — supplied by client.

misfire.text: If you are dealing with an active misfire, call {name} on {phoneDisplay} — this proposal is not an emergency channel.

emergency000.text: For immediate danger or an active emergency, contact emergency services on 000. This proposal is not an emergency-response service.

hp1Framing.text: Acceptance of the quotation and preliminary risk assessment permits progression of planning and site preparation only and does not constitute unconditional authority to undertake blasting.
hp1Framing.adapted: Approval of this preliminary assessment -> Acceptance of the quotation and preliminary risk assessment
